Due to a geopolitical restriction, no direct maritime channel exists between Station Alpha and Station Beta.
Furthermore, operational protocols mandate that precisely one of the following two sea lanes must be incorporated into the circuit: the lane connecting Station Beta and Station Gamma, or the lane connecting Station Gamma and Station Delta.

The objective is to determine the most fuel-efficient closed circuit that calls at each research station exactly once before returning to the point of origin.
